rationale: Plan addresses all aspects of the task: load_tables ingests the medical_claims data; claim_volume with status breakdown and figure produces the status distribution chart; denial_rate with all_claims denominator provides portfolio-level denial context; fraud_prevalence shows fraud label prevalence across all claims; financial_summary with billed_amount, allowed_amount, and paid_amount provides comprehensive financial picture; monthly_trend tracks claim volume trends by adjudication date; write_report compiles findings with descriptive_only caveat per task tag.
